output.narrative:
Revenue decreased by 201.37 (-10.78%), dropping from 1867.88 to 1666.51. This downward movement was primarily driven by requests, which contributed -159.28 to the delta, alongside ecpm, which contributed -43.5. 

Drilling down into ecpm, the decline was disproportionately driven by two independent segments: category=finance (explanatory power 0.988, lift 13.75) and ad_format=video (explanatory power 1.062, lift 8.13). By contrast, category=social had a lift of -0.37 and was ruled out.

Within category=finance, the drop was further concentrated in ad_format=video (explanatory power 0.356, lift 2.69). Within ad_format=video, the issue was further driven by category=finance (explanatory power 0.896, lift 12.35) and country=CA (explanatory power 0.309, lift 3.1). Further drilling down into ad_format=video and country=CA, the drop was once again concentrated in category=finance (explanatory power 1.073, lift 15.03).
